newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says welcomes BOE inflation report.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says welcomes BOE inflation report.

text.p: The British Treasury said it welcomed the quarterly inflation report from the Bank of England and said the differences between its and the BOE's inflation target were "very small".
"As always we welcome the comprehensive review and analysis of inflation trends and pressures," a Treasury spokesman said.
"The differences between the Treasury and BOE on inflation targets are very small and the uncertainties on this type of forecast are very large," he said.
The BOE report said there was now much less chance of inflation below the government's 2.5 pct target in 1997.
